result:
Round 171 (V-3c-4c-3) passes: I ran every acceptance row in real Chromium at 1440×900 and 1280×720 (`browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true). I also found two small bugs in older code that this round didn't touch.

**Results:**
- **Unit tests:** I re-ran A's 19 test files and got 282/282, the same as A. The three new locks (ESU1, ECR1, VFR1) and all the existing ones (HE1–HE6, FS1, LVD1, VDS1–VDS3, TH11, TS1) are present and green.
- **Source scope:** HEAD is still `fe6ea99`. The 984 frozen files match, A's end hashes match, and the protected files are unchanged. The repository was byte-for-byte the same at the end of my phase as at the start.
- **Diff review:** the edits are class names only, exactly the planned changes (S1–S4, K1–K2). The tests only add lines, and the only new bracket values are the four motion tokens.
- **Button surfaces:**
  - **Done and Cancel:** no outline now; the fill steps from 5 % (rest) to 8 % (hover) to 12 % (pressed), with 8 px corners.
  - **Export:** brand border and brand text instead of the solid fill.
  - **Motion:** the fade is 0.18 s with the planned easing, and it turns off with reduced motion.
- **Cancel during an export:** B's probe never caught it. A project of 21 clips across three tracks keeps Cancel on screen for about 4 s, which was enough to measure it, crop it and click it at both sizes.
- **Layout:** every button, card and dock control is exactly where B measured it before the change (0.00 px difference). The full-page layout check also shows no change.
- **Contrast:** Done and Cancel are 13.24 at rest and 12.35 on hover; Export is 7.05 and 6.58. The cards and dock buttons equal B's earlier values.
- **Real actions:**
  - **WAV export:** produces a valid 24-bit, 48 kHz stereo file of 102.352 s, exactly the project length, with real audio in it.
  - **Cancel:** shows "Export cancelled — no file was created." and no file arrives.
  - **Done:** closes the dialog and puts focus back on the transport Export button.
  - **Cards:** clicking the MP3 card switches the choice and the button label.
  - **Video dock** (with a real video): expand floats it; the arrow key moves it 16 px; playback advances the video and pausing stops it. Close, Return and Escape all bring it back to the compact view.
- **Security:** a fresh browser with no login opens the demo page. `/studio/middle-east` still shows "Sign in required" with no audio loaded. The studio-token request returns 401. No Authorization headers or forbidden requests appeared in 44 sessions. The fake-token 403 check is blocked because the backend isn't available in the cloud.

**Bugs for B (both Low, both from before this round, so they go to the deferred Low list):**
- **C-R171-01:** pressing a button in the Export dialog, dragging off onto the dark backdrop and releasing closes the dialog. The cause is the shared `Modal.tsx`, which is protected. It doesn't close while an export is running, so nothing is lost.
- **C-R171-02:** at 1440×900 the dialog's button row drops 31.8 px about 0.2 s into an export, when the progress label appears. Cancel moves out from under the mouse, so a quick click can miss. It doesn't happen at 1280×720.

For Saba to judge: in the 4× crops the dock buttons over the video show some colour from the picture behind them, but the icons stay readable. The Export focus ring sits right against its brand border and looks like a thicker gold outline; that was already the case before this round.

Under the plan for round 172, this means V-3c-4c-3 is done and next is V-3c-5 (10 px panel corners). Two exceptions: the regression round comes first if B plans on or after 2026-10-27, and root's answer to the architecture checkpoint could put an extraction round first. No app source was changed and nothing was committed.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `c-round-171.md`
- `c-round-171.json`
- `c-round-171/` (tools, measurements, screenshots)
